items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Remember Art Ford when he came down there from New York?

ctx.x: When were you on the television there at WDSU? You remember what bands it was? Yeah.

Yeah. With Joy Lewis. And uh, what's that with uh, let me see. Tiny middle. With Emma Barrows. Mmhmm. Yeah. Emma Barrows. Remember Art Ford when he came down there from New York? Yeah, yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
